canonical_api.conceptual_signature: advance_interval(parameters, committed_state, forcing, numerical_config, t0, t1) -> result + candidate_state + diagnostics

fci_runtime_substrate.architectural_role: implementation substrate, not a second canonical production entrypoint

parameters.sharing: may be shared by id/reference outside persistent column state

candidate_state.creation: only after complete accepted requested interval

numerical_configuration.separation_rule: numerical execution policy is not physical configuration

diagnostics.scope: transaction lifecycle and admission diagnostics owned by F-KT

worker_scratch.location: worker/job-bound model and downstream solver implementation

transaction_semantics.warm_start_rule: worker-local numerical start information may be retained but may not replace the committed physical origin

mass_semantics.kernel_mapping: pass through canonical unrounded mass record without recomputation
